purpose: Navigation index for root-only later ordered visual audit; no number is classified as archival or non-archival.

selection_rules.page_selection: Any literal mspage control sequence in a finalized page, including occurrences in percent comments, or an archive sheet number comment present in a recorded edit old fragment and absent by exact-text multiplicity from its new fragment.
selection_rules.removal_limit: This compares recorded old/new edit fragments only. It does not replay edits or prove that a comment disappeared from the full source page. Current-page exact-text presence is reported separately.
selection_rules.mspage_limit: Arguments are extracted lexically with balanced braces; percent-comment status is reported. No macro expansion or TeX execution is inferred.
selection_rules.related_rows: Heuristic keyword search only in root-authored place/final/shows fields; C and H fields are neither searched nor copied. A keyword hit does not establish that the row concerns an archival folio.
selection_rules.unmatched_rows: Rows with no listed keyword hit are not included. No claim of semantic completeness is made.
